packageRules.description: Minor/patch updates of everything not covered by a dedicated group below
Next.js and React move together (React types included)
Prisma CLI, client and adapter must always share the exact same version (Dockerfile pins /prisma-tools from the lockfile)
Automerge patch updates of devDependencies once CI is green (Prisma and React types stay in their own groups)

MySQL server: track LTS only (block Innovation releases such as 9.x/26.x) and keep it out of the minor/patch group. allowedVersions can't be combined with matchUpdateTypes, so approval lives in the next rule.
MySQL server: the 8.0 -> 8.4 move needs a prod migration window, so major/minor updates wait for dashboard approval.
